meta.subject: SOLICITATION FOR THE TRAINING AND EDUCATION INSTRUCTOR OF THE

provision.text: Purpose. This MARADMIN announces the Training and Education Command (TECOM) Instructor of the Year Awards Program for Academic Year 2025 to 2026.

Background. The Commanding General (CG), Training and Education Command (TECOM) established the Instructor of the Year Awards Program to recognize the exceptional service of full-time instructors, faculty advisors, and professors across the TECOM enterprise. Through this program, CG TECOM will recognize 12 formal school instructors/faculty advisors and one (1) Marine Corps Junior Reserve Officer Training Corps (MCJROTC) Instructor for the Academic Year 2025 to 2026 (1 June 2025 through 30 April 2026).
Tasks

provision.label: a.
provision.text: CG Training Command (TRNGCMD) will nominate and endorse one individual for each of the following award categories: TECOM Marksmanship/Small Arms Instructor of the Year, Formal School Instructor of the Year, and Formal School Aviation Instructor of the Year.

provision.label: b.
provision.text: CG Marine Corps Recruit Depot (MCRD) Parris Island and CG MCRD San Diego will nominate and endorse one individual each for the following award category: TECOM Marksmanship/Small Arms Instructor of the Year.

provision.label: c.
provision.text: CG Marine Air Ground Task Force Training Command (MAGTFTC) will nominate and endorse one individual for each of the following award categories: TECOM Marine Air Ground Task Force (MAGTF) Instructor of the Year and Exercise Controller/Instructor of the Year.

provision.label: d.
provision.text: CG Education Command (EDCOM) will nominate and endorse one individual for the following award category: TECOM MCU Faculty Advisor of the Year.

provision.label: e.
provision.text: Director, Marine Corps Junior Reserve Officer Training (MCJROTC) will nominate and endorse one individual for the following award category: TECOM MCJROTC Instructor of the Year.

provision.label: f.
provision.text: CG TECOM will convene the final selection board to determine the winner of TECOM Marksmanship/Small Arms Instructor of the Year.

provision.label: g.
provision.text: Nominating major subordinate commands will originate a Navy and Marine Corps Commendation Medal in iAPS for any military nominees and forward via the chain of command to CG TECOM (M30010) for processing. The first sentence of the Summary of Action (SOA) and Citation will read "Nominee for the 2026 Training and Education Command [Insert Category Title] of the Year.â€

Administration and Logistics

provision.label: a.
provision.text: Submit nomination packages to CG TECOM using the Department of the Navy Enterprise Task Management Software Solutions (ETMS2) to â€œUSMC TECOMâ€ no later than 27 March 2026. Nominations received by USMC TECOM after 27 March 2026 will not be accepted.

provision.label: b.
provision.text: Nomination and eligibility criteria are in accordance with reference (a).
This awards program is applicable to Marines, Sailors, and civilians assigned to TECOM, and to certified MCJROTC instructors.
Any rank, pay grade, or pay scale is eligible.
Nominees must not have any derogatory material or disciplinary actions during Academic Year 2025 to 2026 (1 June 2025 to 30 April 2026), including any pending matters.

Per paragraph 5 of this MARADMIN, nominees must be certified in the applicable Marine Occupational Specialties (MOS) and/or assigned to applicable billet descriptions for no less than 210 days during Academic Year 2025-2026 (1 June 2025 to 30 April 2026). Non-resident or distance education nominees must have served as a faculty advisor and/or instructor for at least 180 days of Academic Year 2025 to 2026.
The nominee must consistently display a high level of performance that significantly and positively impacts mission accomplishment.

provision.label: c.
provision.text: Marines serving in a billet MOS (BMOS) of 0911 (Drill Instructors) or 0913 (Marine Combat Instructors) are not eligible for this program; these Marines compete and are recognized separately through the Commandant of the Marine Corps Combined Awards Program.

Individuals serving in a BMOS that has not yet been officially changed on the table of organization (T/O) to a BMOS of 09XX remain eligible for the Instructor of the Year Awards Program until the T/O is updated accordingly.
